---
title: "Request Support"
---

Use the form below to send us a request — no account of any kind is required.

::: {.callout-note title="How your data is handled" collapse="true"}
The information you submit (name, affiliation, contact email, and your request description)
is used solely to process your service request. It is received in the Microsoft 365
environment of ZALF and automatically transferred to a work-tracking "issue" in our GitHub
repository (GitHub, Inc., USA), where our team manages requests. It is deleted when no
longer required. **Please do not include sensitive personal data** (e.g. health data) or
confidential research data — we will ask for further details through an appropriate channel
once we are in contact.
:::

## Prefer email?

Write to us at [iat-dml@zalf.de](mailto:iat-dml@zalf.de){.dml-contact} with a short description of your request —
it is logged automatically in our tracking system and we will get back to you.

## Already have a GitHub account?

You can open a request directly in our
[service desk](https://github.com/iat-dml/service-desk/issues/new/choose).
